# Simple QR Generator

> A free, no-signup QR code generator supporting SVG and PNG export with color customization.

## Features
- Real-time QR code generation from any URL
- Download as SVG or PNG (128, 256, 512, 1024px)
- Copy QR code to clipboard
- Custom QR color and background with opacity control
- Bilingual interface: Korean and English
- No ads, no registration required
- Works entirely in the browser (no server-side processing)

## URL
https://dev-jonghoonpark.github.io/simple-qr-generator/
